question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Forgetfull"** is a misspelling of the correct word** "Forgetful"**.
 
• The correct word is **"Forgetful"**, which means tending to forget things, often because of absent-mindedness or a lack of attention. (भुलक्कड़)
 
 
• **Example: **He is forgetful and frequently forgets important dates.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Damaged **(क्षतिग्रस्त): Harmed or injured, making it less functional or valuable.

 
 
• **Example:** The car was damaged in the accident.
 
 
 
• **Fantastic **(शानदार): Extraordinarily good or attractive.
 
 
• **Example: **We had a fantastic time at the party.
 
 
 
• **Expensive** (महंगा): Costing a lot of money.
 
 
• **Example:** The watch he bought was very expensive.
